mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( login_id, password, salt, name, email, terms_agreed_at, privacy_agreed ) VALUES ( #{loginId}, #{password}, #{salt}, #{name}, #{email}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{privacyAgreed} )
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, login_id, password, salt, name, email, weight_kg AS weightKg FROM users WHERE login_id = #{loginId} LIMIT 1

SELECT user_id, birth_date, gender, height_cm AS height, weight_kg AS weight, bmi, trait_companion AS companion, trait_competition AS competition, trait_place AS place, trait_intensity AS intensity, -- 성향 4축은 한 번에 저장되므로 하나만 확인하면 완료 여부를 알 수 있다 IF(trait_companion IS NULL, 0, 1) AS onboarding_completed FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
SELECT user_id, name, gender, weight_kg AS weight_kg, bmi, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, birth_date, CURDATE()) AS age FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId}
